ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in rectangle $ABCD$, point $E$ is on $AD$, and $EC$ bisects $\angle BED$. If $\angle ABE=45^\circ$ and $AB=\sqrt{5}$, find the length of $BC$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} In rectangle $ABCD$, $\angle A=90^\circ$, and $\angle ABE=45^\circ$, \\
$\therefore \triangle ABE$ is an isosceles right triangle,\\
$\therefore AE=AB=\sqrt{5}$,\\
$\therefore BE=\sqrt{AE^2+AB^2}=\sqrt{10}$,\\
From (1) we know $BC=BE$,\\
$\therefore BC=\boxed{\sqrt{10}}$.
